messages:
maria (Growth): Quick idea — launch a lightweight local-dev onboarding guide + reference app that doubles as a benchmark narrative. target: community + startups. Thoughts?
ben (DevRel): love it. we should include a simple benchmark: cold-start p50/p95 and token cost for 4 scenarios.
kai (Content): on it. I'll draft tutorial flow: 1) repo clone 2) run local dockerized runtime 3) sample prompt sets. Need a short refapp name.
cleo (Design): can we get a hero screenshot + GIF of local run? 800x420 ok.
sophie (PM): deadlines? webinar tie-in? i'd prefer a short pre-recorded walkthrough + live q&a.
maria (Growth): propose timeline: draft by 05/02, design assets by 05/07, soft-launch blog + post on 05/12, webinar 05/20.
ben (DevRel): for benchmarks i'll include commands and expected outputs. e.g. `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` and measure latency.
kai (Content): draft outline will include a "what we measured" table and a "how to reproduce" section with a single `run-bench.sh`.
cleo (Design): will mock hero+gif. can we get a small screencap tool? suggest `asciinema` for quick gifs.
sophie (PM): inbound routing — ops wants a CTA to a GH issue template + a contact form. marketing should route leads to /forms/refapp-webinar.
maria (Growth): agree. lead routing: set up GTM tag + slack alert to #sales-inbound. @ben can you add a hidden UTM parameter for the webinar?
ben (DevRel): yes. I'll add `utm_source=refapp&utm_campaign=local-onboard` to examples and GH links.
kai (Content): messaging test ideas: A/B subject lines: "Ship LLM features faster" vs "Local LLM dev in 10 minutes". we'll run 2 small email sends.
cleo (Design): will prepare two hero variants for the A/B.
maria (Growth): ok. small checklist: draft, design, bench script, blog post, github refapp, webinar seed emails, inbound forms, GTM, announce on Discord + Hacker News.
sophie (PM): tagging owners: content=kai, devrel=ben, design=cleo, growth=maria. i'll own webinar ops.
maria (Growth): any blockers?
ben (DevRel): need a small infra token for running the benchmark on dedicated hardware — @ops-bot can you provision a 2xA100 test slot for 48h?
ops-bot: Ticket created #INC-4821 — provisioning 2xA100 for 48h, ETA 12 hours.
maria (Growth): perfect. i'll schedule a 30m launch sync on 05/08 and drop agenda.
kai (Content): i'll post draft by EOD 05/02 in this thread for quick feedback.
cleo (Design): will upload hero + GIF drafts to Figma by 05/06.
sophie (PM): noted, will add webinar registration form + run a test flow.
maria (Growth): thanks team! small wins: keep copy concise, bench reproducible, and tutorials fork-friendly. :rocket:
